articles.title: Uttar Pradesh Unveils Robust Labour Reforms
articles.description: The Uttar Pradesh government has introduced comprehensive reforms to improve labour welfare, including mandatory double overtime pay and timely wages in Gautam Buddha Nagar. Measures also focus on weekly holidays, women's safety, and transparent wage payments, setting a model for labour practices in the state.

articles.title: Maharashtra Contractors Unanimously Withdraw Strike After PWD Minister Assures ₹9,000 Crore Extra Funds And Project Extensions
articles.description: Contractors in Maharashtra withdrew their strike after the government assured ₹28,000 crore to clear dues and support ongoing works. The PWD minister also granted project extensions till March 2027, allowed faster bill payments and promised DSR revision. The move is expected to resume stalled infrastructure projects across the state.
